contract: A mixed Desktop moves ordinary groups, preserves private records, and undoes exactly.
Agent mappings move only eligible files, require journaling, and undo exactly.
Document reference surfaces stay protected while unrelated files remain movable and recoverable.
Project roots and referenced assets remain protected while nearby loose files can be organized.
Explicitly allowed synthetic sync locations have an honest apply result.
Apple metadata sidecars remain hidden while ordinary files retain their bytes.
A case-folded destination collision refuses before moving either source.
Known sync paths and Library precedence are recognized without claiming cloud hydration.
Packages stay opaque at every supported scan depth.
Hidden placeholder-shaped files remain untouched beside sortable files.
Unicode-equivalent destination names refuse without losing either distinct source.
Recent, future, and in-flight files remain held according to grace and deadline rules.
Separate roots can apply concurrently without crossing journals or names.
Graceful interruption leaves a recoverable operation at witnessed progress points.
Supplied keys seal journals and unreadable newer history blocks unsafe selection.
Truncated journals refuse or recover without changing unrecorded files.
Killed stash and pop operations resume to the exact original tree without loss or duplicates.
A killed undo resumes to the exact original tree.
Concurrent applies on one root leave an honest, loss-free, exactly recoverable state.
A killed apply leaves every file recoverable without duplication or loss.
Exact multi-parent selections refuse overlaps, preserve unselected siblings and restore original parents without source-path disclosure.
A witnessed source deletion fails honestly and preserves every survivor.
A witnessed destination intruder is never overwritten.
A witnessed source symlink swap never reads, writes, or deletes outside data.
A file written during apply retains its complete final payload.
A file occupying a destination directory prevents a destructive apply.
A witnessed permission change leaves a recoverable, honest result.
The item cap accepts its boundary and refuses the next item without mutation.
Depth limits include only intended paths and preserve the rest.
A 10k camera fixture preserves exact integrity while recording timing.
Large sparse and zero-byte files move and undo without data change.
Mixed recognized families form bounded, distinct destination groups.
Long paths remain intact and unreadable subtrees are disclosed.
Hostile filenames survive plan, apply, and undo without reinterpretation.
Legal case-distinct paths apply safely on a case-sensitive volume.
Cross-device copying preserves content, mtime, and recoverability.
Cross-volume moves preserve data through ordinary and interrupted copy paths.
Same-device exFAT fallback moves files without loss.
Full-volume apply remains honest and recoverable.
Read-only volumes plan but refuse apply without mutation.
Low descriptor limits fail honestly without silently dropping journaling.
An unwritable journal state directory prevents an unjournaled apply.
A partial undo persists progress and resumes after a volume hazard.
Name-only planning avoids content reads and hostile archive members refuse safely.
A killed apply reads back as interrupted with true counts, an unknown operation id is named as such, a contended apply says whether to wait, and status names no file.

A plan written by sweep propose moves only the files it names; an apply killed part-way is reported as interrupted and undo restores every original path and byte, with skipped, unnamed and never-eligible files untouched throughout.
Ordinary archive listing and extraction preserve exact paths and bytes.
Killed unpack never publishes a partial target and retry extracts the exact archive.
Captured archive quarantine is preserved and exactly read back before publication, including AppleDouble storage.
The scenario wrapper propagates failure, signal, and completion status.

A tagged item is left alone and counted without its name, --include-tagged is loud and keeps the tag through move and undo, Finder comments are not read, and an item tagged after planning is not moved.
stash clears tagged items too, keeps their tags through stash and pop, and reports the folder clear only when nothing was left behind.
unpack extracts a small archive made in the scenario to its exact bytes after etude-core changes.
A tagged item whose move would cross volumes stays in place with its tag and is counted by name, in sweep and in stash, while untagged items still cross.

sweep --scheme tags plans and exports a tag plan that writes nothing, lists each tag with its file count and marks new ones, applies only from the exported plan, adds tags after the ones a file has and moves nothing, undoes to the exact previous bytes, leaves a file whose tags changed since apply, skips a file whose tags cannot be read, and refuses a stale plan.
A tag apply killed part-way is reported as interrupted with true counts and repeated undo restores every file's exact previous tag bytes, with personal, hidden and linked files never tagged.
After sweep adds tags, stash holds and pops the folder with those tags intact, sweep undo still restores the earlier tags, and unpack extracts a synthetic archive to its exact bytes.
